description: This file defines an ASP.NET Core MVC controller named CommentsController, responsible for handling HTTP requests related to comments on articles, such as creating, listing, and deleting comments. It interacts with the MediatR library to delegate actions to handlers.

classes.name: CommentsController
classes.description: An ASP.NET Core MVC controller managing comment-related endpoints, utilizing MediatR to process commands and queries.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new comment on an article identified by slug.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve comments for an article identified by slug.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a specific comment identified by id from an article.
